info.title: Azure Machine Learning Workspaces

requests.description: Lists all of the available Azure Machine Learning Workspaces REST API operations.
requests.name: GET /providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/operations
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key

requests.description: Gets the currently assigned Workspace Quotas based on VMFamily.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/locations/{location}/Quotas
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update quota for each VM family in workspace.
requests.name: POST /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/locations/{location}/updateQuotas
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the current usage information as well as limits for AML resources for given subscription and location.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/locations/{location}/usages
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns supported VM Sizes in a location
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/locations/{location}/vmSizes
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets compute definition by its name. Any secrets (storage keys, service credentials, etc) are not returned - use 'keys' nested resource to get them.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/{workspaceName}/computes/{computeName}
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates properties of a compute. This call will overwrite a compute if it exists. This is a nonrecoverable operation.
requests.name: PATCH /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/{workspaceName}/computes/{computeName}
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates or updates compute. This call will overwrite a compute if it exists. This is a nonrecoverable operation. If your intent is to create a new compute, do a GET first to verify that it does not exist yet.
requests.name: PUT /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.MachineLearningServices/workspaces/{workspaceName}/computes/{computeName}
requests.note: Replace {{AZURE_MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKSPACES_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
